title: Woodcutting to 15 and Firemaking to 15

mapLocation.label: The trees behind the castle's west wall

resourceSpots.label: The trees behind the castle's west wall
resourceSpots.note: Ordinary trees (Tree) 15-20 tiles west of the castle gate. Use only them up to Woodcutting 15; oaks (Oak) start at 15.

resourceSpots.label: The canoe station on the River Lum
resourceSpots.note: The east bank of the River Lum, about 10 tiles north of the bridge by the castle. You need an axe: in the bag, in your hands or handed to Barfy Bill (Store-axe).

where: Ordinary trees (Tree) right behind the west wall of Lumbridge Castle: leave the castle gate to the west and walk 15-20 tiles to the grove. Chop and burn the logs right away; no bank is needed.

itemsRequired.howToGet: Given on Tutorial Island. If you lost it, buy one from Bob's Brilliant Axes in south Lumbridge for 16 gp.
Given on Tutorial Island. If you lost it, buy one in the Lumbridge General Store for 1 gp.

fields.label: Canoe
fields.text: Your Woodcutting level decides how many stops you can paddle: 12 - one (Lumbridge to Champions' Guild), 27 - two (to Barbarian Village), 42 - three (to Edgeville). River stops: Lumbridge, Champions' Guild, Barbarian Village, Edgeville. A canoe disappears after the trip, so you chop a new one for every trip. How to travel step by step is in the reference [Teleports, canoes and boats](#/reference/transport).

fields.label: Faster
fields.text: Up to 15, chop ordinary trees (Tree) by the castle and burn the logs at once with the tinderbox. From level 15 move on to oaks (Oak).

fields.label: Keep
fields.text: 1 Ashes in the bank for Prince Ali Rescue. Ashes stay on the ground when a fire burns out.

doneWhen: Woodcutting 15, Firemaking 15 and 1 Ashes in the bank (for S2-10).
quickSteps: Leave Lumbridge Castle by the west gate and chop ordinary trees (Tree) in the grove behind the wall.
Burn every log at once: use the tinderbox (Tinderbox) on the logs (Logs). Move along the row of trees: you cannot light a new fire on the spot of an old one.
Pick up 1 Ashes after a fire and put it in the bank: it is needed for the paste in Prince Ali Rescue (S2-10).
From Woodcutting 15 switch to oaks (Oak) in the same place, and from Firemaking 15 burn oak logs.

From Woodcutting 12 try the canoe: the station is on the east bank of the River Lum, about 10 tiles north of the bridge by the castle. "Chop-down" fells the tree, "Shape-Canoe" picks the Log canoe, "Float Log" launches it, "Paddle Log" chooses the stop.

worldPoint.label: The trees behind the castle's west wall

carryover.why: Prince Ali Rescue needs ashes for the wig dye.

title: Mining to 10
where: The mine south-east of Varrock (South-east Varrock mine): copper, tin and iron in one place, the Varrock East bank is about 60 tiles north-west. From the Chronicle book (Champions' Guild) it is about 1 minute on foot to the east. On the way keep south of the stone circle with the dark wizards (Dark wizard): they attack on their own and hit beginners hard.
how: Up to 10 mine copper (Copper) and tin (Tin) and drop the extra (Shift + click).

itemsRequired.howToGet: Given on Tutorial Island. A better pickaxe (Steel pickaxe) mines faster.

fields.label: Why
fields.text: The Knight's Sword (S2-07) requires Mining 10. The ore for Doric's Quest is bought in S2-01, so no iron is mined here.

fields.label: Put in the bank
fields.text: 1 copper and 1 tin ore to smelt a bronze bar for Prince Ali Rescue.

doneWhen: Mining 10, with 1 copper ore and 1 tin ore in the bank (for S2-10).

carryover.why: Smelted with a tin ore into the Bronze bar of Prince Ali Rescue.
Smelted with a copper ore into the Bronze bar of Prince Ali Rescue.

title: Magic to 25 (Varrock Teleport)
how: After Imp Catcher (875 XP) and Witch's Potion (325) you have Magic 10 without a single spell. After that, cast combat strike spells on the cows in Lumbridge: a cow has 8 health and every one drops a hide, so hides can be collected alongside the XP; selling them is a separate step that may be restricted. Spells of the same tier hit equally hard and equally accurately; they differ in XP and runes: Wind Strike (Magic 1) 5.5 XP, Water Strike (5) 7.5, Earth Strike (9) 9.5, Fire Strike (13) 11.5. The XP goes to both Magic and Hitpoints.

itemsRecommended.howToGet: Instead of an ordinary Staff: it replaces the fire runes for Fire Strike (3 runes per cast). Compare Zaff's shop with the current GE estimate. Check the payback calculation for your planned casts; do not buy it again if you already own one.
Earth Strike (Magic 9-12) uses 2 earth runes per cast. If you go straight to Fire Strike you do not need it.
Fire Strike (from Magic 13) uses 3 fire runes per cast, unless you have a Staff of fire.

For the teleports once you have the level: one Law rune with 3 Air runes and 1 Fire rune per Varrock Teleport (Magic 25), and again for Lumbridge (31) and Falador (37). Buy them at the Grand Exchange on your next stop in Varrock; they are not needed for training.

fields.label: Why
fields.text: Varrock Teleport opens at level 25: Magic tab, Varrock Teleport, costing 1 Law, 3 Air and 1 Fire rune each, and a couple of seconds later you are on the square in the middle of Varrock. When it beats the book and the canoe, see the reference [Teleports, canoes and boats](#/reference/transport).

fields.label: Budget
fields.text: The exact calculation is in the "How much it costs to reach Magic 25" block below: it takes your XP from the game and the Grand Exchange prices. The most expensive is Fire Strike without a staff: 3 fire runes, 2 air and 1 mind per cast.

fields.label: If you are short of money
fields.text: Start with an affordable batch of runes and a usable staff you already own. Cowhides are not available coins, and a new account may be unable to sell them. Check Money for methods that suit your levels, supplies and account selling limits before funding the next batch.

doneWhen: Magic 25.

mapLocation.label: The cow field east of Lumbridge

resourceSpots.label: The cow field — hit cows, every one drops a hide
Aubury's Rune Shop — Air and Mind runes

itemsRequired.howToGet: Buy from Zaff in Zaff's Superior Staffs (Varrock) for about 15 gp: with a staff the spell can be set to autocast. A Staff of fire (below) works instead.

Needed for every cast unless a staff supplies air. Take an affordable batch to start; check your remaining runes and coins before buying more. Cowhide sales must actually be available before they can fund another batch.
Needed for every cast (1 each). In Aubury's Rune Shop it is 3 gp. Take 300 to start.

quickSteps: Buy Air and Mind runes in Aubury's Rune Shop in Varrock (300 each to start): in the shop they are 4 and 3 gp. Compare the current GE estimates before buying.
Buy a staff from Zaff in Zaff's Superior Staffs (Varrock): an ordinary Staff is about 15 gp, which is enough to autocast a spell. A Staff of fire costs more but replaces the fire runes.
Wield the staff, open the combat tab (Combat Options), click the spell button and choose the autocast spell: Wind Strike first.
Go to the cow field near Lumbridge and hit the cows: each has 8 health, and a hide (Cowhide) always drops. Pick up the hides; a full inventory goes to the bank or the exchange.
Change the autocast spell with your level: Magic 5 Water Strike, 9 Earth Strike, 13 Fire Strike. Fire Strike gives the most XP per cast.
Continue to Magic 25: Varrock Teleport unlocks. Replenish runes from confirmed coins or an available earning method in Money; do not rely on unsold hides.

title: Strength to 20 and Attack to 30

mapLocation.label: The Stronghold of Security entrance, Barbarian Village mine

where: The Stronghold of Security, floor 1 (the Vault of War): the level 12 Minotaurs (the level 27 ones are further in). The entrance is in the Barbarian Village mine, the same place as S1-09. There is no bank on the floor: bank in Edgeville first.
how: Train Strength to 20 on Aggressive (Slash on a scimitar), then Attack to 30 on Accurate (Chop). Follow the selected combat plan if it uses a different order or opponent. Dragon Slayer I later gives 18,650 Defence XP; training Defence earlier does not remove that reward. Compare extra training time with the food and banking it could save before changing the plan. Food and time are an estimate until measured in game.
membersAlternative: 👑 With membership: do not fight mobs by hand: complete Waterfall Quest in 15 minutes and get 30 Attack and 30 Strength at once!
doneWhen: Strength 20 and Attack 30. Defence is left alone.

itemsRequired.howToGet: From S2-01: wield it.

Buy on the Grand Exchange; check the current acquisition estimate; Trout (heals 7), Tuna, Lobster or Swordfish count too. Preparation estimates the food for your current levels and worn gear. Or catch and cook your own at Barbarian Village (fly fishing, Fishing 30 for salmon).

itemsRecommended.howToGet: Grand Exchange; check the current acquisition estimate. A dose about every 5 minutes; 3 potions (12 doses) are about an hour. Potions with fewer doses left count the same.
From S2-01: wear it (+10 strength, one more max hit at these levels).
From S3-07: Attack 30 ends this step, then wield it for S4-03.

quickSteps: Bank in Edgeville: fill the bag with Salmon (or other fish) and take the Strength potions; wear the Mithril scimitar and the Amulet of strength. Come back to the bank when the food runs out.
Enter the Stronghold of Security in the Barbarian Village mine and go to the Minotaurs on floor 1 (the Vault of War).
Fight the level 12 Minotaurs: Aggressive (Slash) to Strength 20, then Accurate (Chop) to Attack 30. Eat at 4 health; drink a Strength potion dose every 5 minutes.

inGame.goal: Stronghold of Security floor 1: the level 12 Minotaurs

pathWaypoints.label: The Stronghold of Security entrance: climb down
Floor 1 (Vault of War): the level 12 Minotaurs

fields.label: Which Minotaurs
fields.text: The level 12 ones. At Defence 1 a level 12 Minotaur hits about 2 times in 3 for up to 2; a level 27 one about 3 times in 4 for up to 3. For the same XP the level 27 ones take about twice the food (an estimate from the wiki stats and the combat formulas). Neither is aggressive, so you choose when to fight.

fields.label: Food
fields.text: At Defence 1 a level 12 Minotaur takes about 3 hit points a kill, and you heal 1 a minute: plan about 1 Salmon for every 3 kills (an estimate). Eat when your health drops to 4, two of their hits. A full bag (about 26 Salmon) lasts about 70 kills; the whole step from Attack 22 and Strength 16 is about 80 Salmon. With the game linked, Food and time works it out from your own levels, gear and kills.

fields.label: Strength potions
fields.text: A dose raises Strength by 3 plus 10% (+4 or +5 here). The higher max hit kills faster in both parts of the step, so the potion speeds up Attack training as well. The boost drops 1 level a minute: drink a dose about every 5 minutes.

fields.label: Pace
fields.text: A level 12 Minotaur has 10 hit points: 40 XP per kill in the skill of your style. The pace line counts the kills left from your real XP, first to Strength 20 and then to Attack 30, and names the style. Its time is an estimate until a few kills are measured.

fields.label: Weapon
fields.text: Wield the Mithril scimitar and wear the Amulet of strength. The Adamant scimitar needs Attack 30, which ends this step: take it along and wield it for S4-03.

fields.label: Defence
fields.text: Leave it at 1. The Anti-dragon shield from S5-02 stops Elvarg's fire at any Defence level.

title: Attack to 40
where: Fight level 13 Giant frogs on the surface of Lumbridge Swamp, south of Lumbridge Castle. Do not enter the caves: those frogs are level 99. Refill food at Lumbridge Castle bank.

itemsRequired.howToGet: From step S3-07. Wear it until Attack 40: the Rune scimitar needs 40 Attack.

Buy on the Grand Exchange if not already owned. Food for one trip; preparation estimates the amount from your equipment and levels. Refill at Lumbridge Castle bank. The full goal may need several trips.

itemsRecommended.howToGet: Grand Exchange; check the current acquisition estimate. A dose every 4-5 minutes: a higher max hit shortens every fight, so it saves food too.

fields.label: Goals
fields.text: Train Attack to 40 on Accurate (Chop on a scimitar). Available opponents are compared for your current levels and gear. Big bones are optional loot, not a completion requirement.

fields.label: Money
fields.text: Use Money if the next purchase is unaffordable. Funding is separate from training: no mandatory 50-bone quota or Hill Giant detour. Bones are not coins until sold.

fields.label: Food
fields.text: Use the current preparation estimate. Refill before food runs out. Times and food are estimates: competition for spawns and actual combat results can change them.

fields.label: Armour
fields.text: Before Attack training, reach Defence 10 on cows using Defensive (Block on a scimitar). Then equip a Black full helm, Black platebody, Black platelegs or plateskirt, and Black kiteshield, or usable equivalent/better pieces you already own. Black armour requires 10 Defence. Withdraw owned pieces first; buy only needed upgrades on the Grand Exchange, checking current preparation prices and keeping coins for food. Estimates use actual worn gear; purchase costs and the shopping detour are extra. An explicit Defence 1 build bypasses this preparation.

fields.label: Weapon
fields.text: Use the Adamant scimitar until Attack 40, then check Gear for an affordable upgrade.

membersAlternative: With membership, check quest-driven training before grinding: quest rewards may cover part of the goal.
doneWhen: Attack 40. No bone quota or Defence requirement.
quickSteps: Take the food shown in preparation; wield your Adamant scimitar and available melee gear.
Go to the level 13 Giant frogs on the surface of Lumbridge Swamp. Stay above ground.
Train on Accurate (Chop on a scimitar) to Attack 40. Refill at Lumbridge Castle bank as needed. Big bones are optional.

title: Fishing to 35 and Cooking to 68
where: Follow the current Fishing method to 35, then Cooking to 68: wine from Cooking 35 is the fastest Cooking in both modes. No Karamja trip or harpoon is required.

itemsRequired.howToGet: The starter net is from Gerrant in Port Sarim. The live method selects the tool for your actual Fishing level; fly fishing uses a fly fishing rod and feathers from 20.

fields.label: Plan
fields.text: Follow the current trainer and its supplies. Net fish from 1; fly fishing opens at 20. The shared planner compares cooking your catch beside the spot with finishing Cooking separately.

fields.label: Stop here
fields.text: Fishing 35 is the F2P checkpoint: members fish far faster from there. Cooking goes on to 68 because wine (from 35, up to 470,000–490,000 XP/h near 68, about 66 gp lost per jug) is the fastest Cooking for members too (OSRS Wiki).

doneWhen: Fishing 35 and Cooking 68. Skip any optional training you do not want before membership.

resourceSpots.label: Net fishing — Draynor Village (Fishing 1-20)
resourceSpots.note: Small fishing net: shrimps, then anchovies from 15.

resourceSpots.label: Fly fishing — Barbarian Village (Fishing 20-35)
resourceSpots.note: Fly fishing rod and feathers: trout from 20, salmon from 30.

title: Mining to 45, Woodcutting to 36 and Firemaking to 50

mapLocation.label: Copper and tin — East Lumbridge Swamp mine (Mining 1-15)

fields.label: Plan
fields.text: Follow Mining to 45, Woodcutting to 36, then Firemaking to 50. Each phase uses the current Skills method, usable owned tools and its actual supplies; bank the previous phase tools before starting the next.

fields.label: Why these levels
fields.text: 45 is a sensible iron-mining checkpoint. Woodcutting 36 prepares Lost City. Firemaking 50 unlocks members Wintertodt. Mining Guild 60 and yews 60 are not required before membership.

fields.label: Supplies
fields.text: Keep logs you want to burn when the bank trip is practical. Firemaking selects logs your level allows; do not burn all logs before checking upcoming needs. No long grind or purchase is required to subscribe.

fields.label: Requirements
fields.text: Mining 1. Each later phase checks its own level, tool and materials.

doneWhen: Mining 45, Woodcutting 36 and Firemaking 50. These are optional checkpoints, not membership requirements.

itemsRequired.howToGet: Use an owned pickaxe that your Mining level allows; withdraw it first. Only buy a tool when no usable owned alternative is available.

title: Magic to 55 (High Level Alchemy)
how: Follow the current spell and its listed supplies. Strike spells are the budget fallback; at Magic 43 and Smithing 15, compare a prepared Superheat Item batch. Alchemy requires chosen expendable targets and verified costs; it is not an automatic unfunded default. Magic 55 unlocks High Level Alchemy but does not guarantee profit.

itemsRequired.howToGet: Starter Wind Strike batch; the current method replaces this with its actual supplies.
Wind Strike uses one air per cast; an equipped owned Staff of air can replace it.
Starter combat food, not the whole goal. Bank when supplies run out.

doneWhen: Magic 55.

fields.label: Optional checkpoint
fields.text: Magic 55 unlocks High Level Alchemy; it is not required before membership. Train only while the current spell and supplies fit your budget. High Alchemy is not guaranteed profit; use Money for a funding plan when needed.

fields.label: Requirements
fields.text: Magic 1. The current method checks its actual spell and Smithing unlocks.

where: The current method supplies its location after your Magic level is checked.

title: Ranged to 40: prepare your kit and follow the current trainer

mapLocation.label: Port Sarim docks — level 3 Seagulls (Ranged starter)

where: Port Sarim docks: select level 3 Seagulls when starting Ranged.

fields.label: Optional branch
fields.text: Prepare for membership at your own pace. Ranged 40 is the default checkpoint; no Bond or full optional grind is required. No purchase or combat is automated.

fields.label: Requirements
fields.text: Ranged 1. Higher Ranged, Defence and quest requirements are checked separately. Reuse suitable owned equipment; open the bank when quantities are unread. Expensive cosmetic variants are not required.

fields.label: Training
fields.text: Follow the current Skills recommendation: it checks your level, worn gear, bank, coins and prices. Prepare the selected kit, then follow the arrow. Use Accurate to Ranged 5, then Rapid, matching the model. The trainer and kit refresh as your levels and supplies change.

fields.label: Arrows
fields.text: One shot in five loses its arrow (OSRS Wiki, Arrows); the rest land under the target. Pick them up between kills and a stack lasts about five times longer; nothing collects them for you without an Ava's device, which needs membership.

fields.label: Ogresses later
fields.text: Ogresses are a later income choice, not a Ranged 1-50 default. At 50 they are still slow; compare Money with your actual gear, supplies and current market before choosing them. The Corsair Curse opens their dungeon.

fields.label: Equipment
fields.text: Shortbows unlock at Ranged 1, 5, 20 and 30. The live plan selects compatible owned or affordable equipment. Leather, studded and green dragonhide depend on levels and quests. Amulet of power or a budget Amulet of accuracy; no Amulet of strength upgrade. Cape and boots are secondary; no ring purchase is required.

doneWhen: Ranged 40. A useful F2P checkpoint, not a requirement for membership. Continue to 50 only if you choose to stay F2P.

itemsRequired.howToGet: A compatible equipped bow and starter arrow stack. Withdraw owned usable supplies first; do not buy replacements for an adequate owned loadout.
A compatible equipped bow and starter arrow stack. Withdraw owned usable supplies first; do not buy replacements for an adequate owned loadout.

title: Agility to 25 (for The Grand Tree)
where: 1-25: Gnome Stronghold Agility Course (Tree Gnome Stronghold, next to the start of The Grand Tree): no falls, no food needed. Or the Draynor Village Rooftop Course, which is also open from level 1. Both give about 10 thousand XP an hour.

fields.label: Why
fields.text: The Grand Tree requires 25 Agility. The quest itself gives another 7,900 Agility XP: from level 25 that is about 31 at once.

fields.label: Mark of Grace
fields.text: Marks of Grace appear on the roofs of the courses: pick them up, since the Graceful set is later assembled from them (S8-03).

doneWhen: Agility 25.

title: Agility to 40 (the Graceful outfit is optional)

itemsRecommended.howToGet: Pick them up on the roofs of the courses.

fields.label: Optional
fields.text: Nothing later in the route needs Agility above 25 (The Grand Tree, S7-04). Agility 40 and the Graceful outfit only make running cheaper: do it when you want it, not before the quests that follow.

fields.label: Courses
fields.text: 1-20: Gnome Stronghold Agility Course or Draynor Village Rooftop Course (both from level 1); 20-30: Al Kharid Rooftop Course; 30-40: Varrock Rooftop Course; from 40: Canifis Rooftop Course (needs Priest in Peril). The whole plan to 99 is on the Agility skill page.

fields.label: Graceful
fields.text: The set is bought from Grace in the Rogues' Den under the pub in Burthorpe for Marks of Grace: the full set is 260 marks. It weighs almost nothing, and the full set speeds up run energy recovery by 30%. Most marks are on the Canifis course.

doneWhen: Agility 40. Graceful pieces and Marks of Grace are a bonus, not a condition.

title: Ranged to 30, Slayer to 18, Crafting to 31, Woodcutting to 36 and Cooking to 10

mapLocation.label: Varrock Museum — Orlando Smith's quiz in the basement (Slayer)

resourceSpots.label: Varrock Museum — Orlando Smith's quiz in the basement (Slayer)
Draynor Village — the Porcine of Interest notice board (Slayer), willows (Woodcutting)
The cow field east of Lumbridge (Ranged)

fields.label: Why
fields.text: Animal Magnetism (S8-05) needs Ranged 30, Slayer 18, Crafting 19 and Woodcutting 35; Lost City (S9-01) needs Crafting 31 and Woodcutting 36; Recipe for Disaster (S9-05) needs Cooking 10. The route up to here leaves Woodcutting at 15 and Cooking at 4 (stage 6 is only the optional Bond branch), so this step trains all five. It unlocks Animal Magnetism (Ava's device), Lost City (Zanaris and the Dramen staff) and the Culinaromancer's Chest.

fields.label: Ranged 30
fields.text: Shoot cows in the Lumbridge pasture from a distance with a bow and arrows set to the Accurate style. Use the best bow your level allows: Oak shortbow (level 5), Willow shortbow (level 20), Maple shortbow (level 30), with Iron or Steel arrows first, Mithril arrows from 20. Bring 200-300 arrows and the bow you will use, and pick the arrows up as you go. Faster, as this is a members world: darts on the Rapid style, a throw every 2 ticks against 3 for a shortbow on Rapid (wiki attack speeds: dart 3, shortbow 4, Rapid one less). Steel darts from Ranged 5, Mithril darts from 20, bought on the Grand Exchange at the current market price; bring about 500 and pick them up, they reach only 3 tiles. Stop at 30 for Animal Magnetism; train to 50 only if you want Ava's accumulator (the S8-05 tip).

fields.label: Slayer 18
fields.text: Take the cheap XP first: the Varrock Museum quiz (talk to Orlando Smith, basement) gives 1,000 XP and the short quest A Porcine of Interest (the notice board in Draynor Village) another 1,000, which is level 13. For the rest do one or two tasks from the master Mazchna in Canifis (after Priest in Peril); Turael in Burthorpe gives short tasks with little XP. Stop at 18.

fields.label: Crafting 31
fields.text: Nature Spirit (S8-02) has already given 3,000 XP. From there make jewellery at a furnace with the mould in the bag: gold amulets from Crafting 8 (30 XP each), sapphire rings from 20 (40 XP each), emerald rings from 27 (55 XP each). Buy gold bars and cut gems on the Grand Exchange rather than mining them. Stop at 31.

fields.label: Woodcutting 36
fields.text: Cut oaks (level 15) and then willows (level 30) beside the Draynor Village bank: about 38 XP per oak log and 68 per willow log, and the logs can be sold or burned for Firemaking. 36 needs about 22,000 XP above level 15, roughly 330 willow logs. Use the best axe your level allows.

fields.label: Cooking 10
fields.text: Cook what you already hold on a range or a fire: level 10 is 1,154 XP and Cook's Assistant already gave 300, so 854 XP is left. Cook raw shrimps (30 XP each, about 29 successful cooks) or raw sardines (40 XP each, about 22; both from level 1), or herring from level 5 (50 XP). Trout needs Cooking 15 and cannot be cooked yet. Bring 10-15 more than that: some burn.

fields.label: Order
fields.text: Do Slayer first (it needs no money), then Woodcutting and Cooking (they pay for themselves), then Crafting while you wait for arrows to restock, then Ranged. Check the levels with the Skills page: the goals above are the only targets of this step.

doneWhen: Ranged 30, Slayer 18, Crafting 31, Woodcutting 36, Cooking 10.
where: Five places in turn: cows in the Lumbridge pasture for Ranged, the Varrock Museum and Draynor Village for the quick Slayer XP, any furnace (Edgeville, Al Kharid or Falador) for Crafting, the Draynor Village willows for Woodcutting and any range for Cooking.

itemsRecommended.howToGet: Buy on the Grand Exchange. Ranged 5. Replace it with a Willow shortbow at 20 and a Maple shortbow at 30.
Buy on the Grand Exchange; pick them up again as you shoot. Mithril arrows from Ranged 20.
Buy on the Grand Exchange: for the gold amulets and rings of the Crafting part.
General Store or the Grand Exchange.

tasks.text: Varrock Museum quiz: talk to Orlando Smith in the basement (1,000 Slayer XP).

A Porcine of Interest (optional quest): read the notice board in Draynor Village, talk to Sarah at the South Falador Farm, use a rope on the Strange Hole east of Draynor Manor, then kill Sourhog (level 37) and cut off its foot. Bring a rope, a knife or slash weapon, combat gear and food.

title: Prayer to 43 (Protect from Melee)
where: The Ectofuntus in Port Phasmatys (Morytania). The bank is in Port Phasmatys, a few steps from the temple.
how: Buy the bones, grind them, fill buckets with slime, and worship the Ectofuntus. Each offering gives four times the Prayer XP of burying the same bone.

itemsRequired.howToGet: From The Restless Ghost (S1-06). Worn, it lets you talk to the ghost disciple who pays the ecto-tokens.
Per trip. Use Big bones (60 XP each) or Dragon bones (288 XP each) instead: buy them on the Grand Exchange, the live price is in the app. Keep the Big bones from S4-03 if you still have them.
Per trip: they hold the bonemeal. General Store, 1 gp.
Per trip: they hold the slime. General Store, 2 gp.

fields.label: Why
fields.text: Monkey Madness I (S9-04) asks for Protect from Melee all through the Ape Atoll dungeon and Protect from Magic against the Jungle Demon, which hits up to 32 with both magic and melee. Protect from Melee needs Prayer 43, so this level is a requirement of that quest, not a bonus.

fields.label: Quest XP first
fields.text: The Restless Ghost, Priest in Peril, Recruitment Drive and Holy Grail give 14,531 Prayer XP together, which is level 30. Two of them are already on your route. Holy Grail alone gives 11,000 Prayer XP and 15,300 Defence XP (after Merlin's Crystal, with Attack 20 for Excalibur, and a level 120 Black Knight Titan to beat), so do it first if you want to save the bones. The two lamps (X Marks the Spot, The Ides of Milk) are already counted.

fields.label: Default method
fields.text: Offer bones at the Ectofuntus: safe, no skill requirement and four times the XP of burying. A bone gives 18 XP, a Big bone 60 and a Dragon bone 288. About 180 offerings an hour: Big bones are about 10,800 XP an hour, Dragon bones about 52,000. Dragon bones are the fast way and cost more, Big bones the cheap and slow one.

fields.label: How an offering goes
fields.text: Use a bucket on the pool of slime (it fills every bucket in the bag). Go upstairs and use the bones on the bone grinder loader, not bury them: it makes bonemeal. Click the Ectofuntus with bonemeal and a bucket of slime to worship. A ghost disciple pays 5 ecto-tokens for each offering while you wear the Ghostspeak amulet.

fields.label: Alternative
fields.text: Offering plain bones at the Chaos altar in the Wilderness is cheaper per XP, but other players can attack you there: it is not part of this route.

doneWhen: Prayer 43.

title: Set up the RuneLite client
where: The RuneLite client, launched through the Jagex Launcher.
how: Enable the Quest Helper, Ground Items, Item Prices, Idle Notifier and GPU (or 117 HD) plugins. Turn on two-factor authentication (2FA) on your Jagex Account right away: without it Stronghold of Security (step S1-09) will not hand out the 10,000 coins.

fields.label: Starting money
fields.text: After Tutorial Island your starting coins are limited. Stronghold of Security offers 10,000 coins; use Money for other eligible methods. Check Preparation before spending, and do not count unsold cowhides as cash.

doneWhen: The Quest Helper panel is visible in the right-hand tab of the client and two-factor authentication is on.

title: Sort out your inventory at the Lumbridge bank
where: The Lumbridge Castle bank, on the top floor of the castle.
how: Keep only an axe, a pickaxe, a net and a tinderbox in your inventory; put everything else in the bank.

itemsRequired.howToGet: Given on Tutorial Island. If you lost it, buy one from Bob's Brilliant Axes in south Lumbridge for 16 gp or pick one up near Farmer Fred's house.
Given on Tutorial Island. If you lost it, buy one from Bob's Brilliant Axes in Lumbridge for 1 gp.
Given on Tutorial Island. If you lost it, there is one beside the Fishing tutor in Lumbridge Swamp (it respawns), or buy one from Gerrant in Port Sarim for 5 gp.
Given on Tutorial Island. If you lost it, buy one in the Lumbridge General Store (north-east of the castle) for 1 gp.

doneWhen: Your inventory is free for quests and gathering.

title: Buy the Chronicle book in Draynor Village

itemsRequired.howToGet: Buy one from Diango (the toy shop in the Draynor Village market) for 300 gp.
Buy from Diango from 150 gp each and use them on the book: it holds up to 1,000 charges.
The book 300 and ten cards from 150 each (Diango's price rises when you buy many at once). The money comes from Stronghold of Security (S1-09).

fields.label: Why
fields.text: The book takes you to Champions' Guild at the south edge of Varrock in a couple of seconds, from where the Grand Exchange is a couple of minutes' walk. The main fast F2P transport until Varrock Teleport (Magic 25).

fields.label: Budget
fields.text: The book costs 300 gp; cards start at 150 gp each, and Diango's price rises if you buy many at once. Buy only the charges you need and check the actual shop total. Stronghold of Security (S1-09) provides the initial funds.

doneWhen: The Chronicle is charged with 10 cards and is in your inventory.
quickSteps: Go to the Draynor Village market and find Diango: right-click him, Trade.
Buy the Chronicle book (300 gp) and 10 Teleport cards (from 150 gp).
Charge the book: pick a card (Use) and click the book. All the cards in your bag are used: 10 cards give 10 teleports.
To teleport, right-click the book, Teleport. A plain click does not teleport; it wields the book in the shield slot.
To see how many charges are left, right-click, Check charges. When the book is better and when a canoe or Varrock Teleport is, see the reference [Teleports, canoes and boats](#/reference/transport).

title: Money for the shopping: cowhides

mapLocation.label: The cow field east of Lumbridge

where: The cow field north-east of Lumbridge Castle, across the river (Lumbridge cow field).
how: Kill cows (level 2) and pick up the hides (Cowhide). A full inventory is 28 hides. The bank is in Lumbridge Castle (2nd floor), or sell straight on the Grand Exchange.

fields.label: How much you need
fields.text: Use Shopping to price the required S2-01 materials from current quotes and confirmed ownership. Keep quest essentials ahead of optional upgrades. If coins are short, use Money; do not assume cowhides or Magic training will cover purchases before an eligible sale completes.

fields.label: Price
fields.text: Use Money for current hide and leather sale estimates. After Prince Ali Rescue, Ellis in Al Kharid tans cowhides for 1 gp each. Compare the net proceeds after tanning and travel before choosing.

fields.label: Bonus
fields.text: Attack, Strength and Defence rise as well, and cows drop bones: bury them for Prayer.

fields.label: New account
fields.text: A new free-to-play account cannot sell cowhides or leather on the Grand Exchange until it has 20 hours of play, 10 quest points and total level 100. Do not count unsold hides as coins. Check Shopping for the current required cost and Money for eligible funding; keep optional upgrades behind quest essentials.

doneWhen: 12,000+ coins in the bag or the bank (together with what is left from Stronghold). Unsold hides are not coins.

title: Big shopping on the Grand Exchange
how: Teleport with the Chronicle book (right-click the book, Teleport) to Champions' Guild and go north to the Grand Exchange, away from the stone circle of dark wizards to the north-east. Sell the hides first, then buy. Check the current GE estimates in Shopping before placing offers; execution prices can differ.

fields.label: Budget
fields.text: Use the current Shopping total for missing supplies; it changes with prices and confirmed stock. To save, the pink skirt is sold by Thessalia in Varrock for 2 gp. Compare making dyes at Aggie with buying them; preserve coins for quest essentials before optional gear or potions.

fields.label: New account
fields.text: A new free-to-play account cannot sell cowhides (or leather, iron ore, clay, copper or tin ore, coal, steel bars, oak or yew logs, lobsters, ashes, feathers, the low runes and a few more) on the Grand Exchange until it has 20 hours of play, 10 quest points and total level 100; buying is not restricted. Without selling, buy in this order: the quest materials, then the Imp Catcher beads and the iron and steel scimitars, then, as coins allow, the mithril scimitar, the amulet of strength and the energy potions. Do not skip the first two groups for the third.

doneWhen: All the items are bought and are in your Grand Exchange bank.
v2ChangesSummary: V2 expands the shopping list: Amulet of strength, Energy potion, Redberry pie, scimitars, iron bars, dyes and clay. Check your bank!

branches.label: Teleport with the Chronicle book
branches.replacementText: Right-click the Chronicle book, Teleport (uses 1 charge): you arrive at Champions' Guild, and from there walk north through Varrock to the Exchange. Avoid the stone circle with the dark wizards to the north-east.

title: Money for the Adamant scimitar: iron ore
where: The mine south-east of Varrock (3 iron veins) or the Al Kharid mine (free passage after Prince Ali). The bank is Varrock East or Al Kharid.
how: Reach the 2,500 gp coin target for the Adamant scimitar using an eligible method from Money. If iron mining is selected, Mining 15 is required; mine copper/tin first if needed. Use the current sale estimate to choose the batch, and stop when confirmed coins meet the target. Unsold ore is not cash; this target does not fund an entire armour set.

fields.label: How much you need
fields.text: This funds the Adamant scimitar (S3-07). The route uses a 2,500 gp savings target; check its current market estimate before buying. The stage 3 quests already give about 5,300 coins (Black Knights' Fortress 2,500, Below Ice Mountain 2,000, Shield of Arrav 600, Doric 180), so you may have it before you mine anything. Armour is skipped on purpose: see S3-08. Use Money to fund Wormbrain and later purchases if short.

fields.label: Price
fields.text: Check Money for current iron-ore proceeds. Unsold ore is not cash. Keep the ore still required by your route.

fields.label: Other ways
fields.text: Compare tanning eligible cowhides with other available methods in Money. Include purchase/tanning costs and the current net sale estimate; do not rely on a fixed leather price.

fields.label: New account
fields.text: A new free-to-play account cannot sell iron ore (or leather) on the Grand Exchange until it has 20 hours of play, 10 quest points and total level 100. The stage 3 quests usually pay the 2,500 gp anyway; if they have not, mine only what the quests need and use Money to find an available alternative.

doneWhen: 2,500+ coins in the bag or the bank (unsold ore does not count).

title: Buy the Adamant scimitar on the Grand Exchange

itemsRequired.howToGet: Needs 30 Attack.

fields.label: Requirement
fields.text: The Adamant scimitar can be wielded only with 30 Attack: buy it now, wield it after step S3-08.

fields.label: Budget
fields.text: Use the current acquisition estimate in Preparation or Shopping.

fields.label: Armour
fields.text: Use armour your current Defence allows; Adamant armour requires 30 Defence. Compare an upgrade's cost with the food and banking it could save. Training Defence earlier does not remove Dragon Slayer I's later XP reward.

fields.label: Amulet
fields.text: Keep your current amulet unless Gear shows a worthwhile change for your levels and opponent. Strength can improve max hit; power adds accuracy and defence. Neither is always faster: max-hit breakpoints and the target's defence matter.

fields.label: Food and potions
fields.text: Prepare food and Strength potions for the selected S3-08 combat plan in the same shopping trip. Shopping estimates the whole goal; the food you carry is one bank trip. Confirm your levels, kit and bank stock before relying on the quantity.

doneWhen: The Adamant scimitar is bought and is in the bank.

branches.label: Varrock Teleport
branches.replacementText: Magic tab, Varrock Teleport (1 **Law rune**, 3 **Air rune**, 1 **Fire rune**): you are on the square by the fountain. The Grand Exchange is north-west of the square.

title: Food for the dragon: buy 20 Lobster
where: The Grand Exchange: buy the cooked Lobster in one go. No trip to Karamja.

itemsRequired.howToGet: Buy cooked Lobster on the Grand Exchange. Preparation shows the quantity cost. Heals 12.

fields.label: Why not catch them
fields.text: Lobsters need Fishing 40 and Cooking 40 and a boat to Musa Point, hours of work that add nothing to the fight. Buying them is far faster.

doneWhen: 20+ cooked Lobster in the bag or the bank.
how: Buy 20 cooked Lobster on the Grand Exchange. Preparation and Shopping show the current quantity cost; check the offer before buying. This replaces the old Karamja cage-fishing loop: lobsters need Fishing 40 and Cooking 40 and a boat each way, hours of work that add nothing to the fight. Any lobsters that drop on the way count towards the 20.

title: Buy all the materials for the dragon on the Grand Exchange
how: Forging steel nails needs Smithing 34. Compare the current Shopping cost of the required materials, and keep the separate 2,000 coins for the ship. Buy only what is still missing.

itemsRequired.howToGet: 30 nails for each plank.
Only ordinary planks.

title: Get the Anti-dragon shield

npc.dialogue: Say that you are going to kill the dragon: he gives you the Anti-dragon shield for free.

proTip: Drop the shield on the floor, talk to the Duke again and take a second one: a spare shield comes in handy if you are killed on the island!
doneWhen: The Anti-dragon shield is in the bank.

dialogChoices: I seek a shield that will protect me from dragonbreath.
Elvarg, the dragon of Crandor island!
So, are you going to give me the shield or not?

quickSteps: Go to Lumbridge Castle to Duke Horacio on the second floor (the 1st floor by the wiki's numbering): "I seek a shield that will protect me from dragonbreath.", "Elvarg, the dragon of Crandor island!", "Yes", "So, are you going to give me the shield or not?".
Take the Anti-dragon shield. If you lost it, Oziach in Edgeville sells the same one (after Dragon Slayer I has been started).

title: Choose membership, or keep playing F2P
how: Ready for membership? Activate it through your chosen payment method, then switch the app to Members mode. You do not need to finish Optional or earn a Bond first. Staying F2P? Continue a Skills plan or open Money for current earning methods.
doneWhen: Membership is active and Members mode is selected, or mark this optional decision complete yourself.
quickSteps: Ready for membership: activate it, then select Members mode in the app.
Staying F2P: choose a Skills plan or open Money; no fixed grind is required.
A Bond is optional. Check its current price and your budget before any manual purchase.
